arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent animation sprite correction
Input images: Image 1 is the current approved polished SMDATE6 019 sprite and is the edit target. Image 2 is the approved SMDATE6 018 mango-design consistency anchor. Image 3 is the original 019 pose guide.
Primary request: Replace only the strange green leafy food bundle across the mermaid's two open palms with the same single whole ripe mango shown in Image 2.
Mango continuity: match Image 2's compact oval shape, scale, warm golden yellow-orange body, restrained red blush, small muted green top patch, tiny short stem, highlight treatment, black outline, and orientation as closely as possible. NO leaves, NO leafy bundle, NO second fruit, NO sliced fruit.
Composition: keep the mango in exactly the same low hand-held area, supported horizontally by both hands.
Style/medium: match the established polished late-1990s cartoon sprite, bold clean black outline, smooth cel shading and highlights.
Constraints: Change only the food object and the minimum finger contact needed to hold it. Preserve pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible Image 1's approved mermaid identity, closed eyes, closed-mouth smile, head angle, face, hair, cyan headband, green swimsuit, torso, both arm positions, both hands, crop, proportions, line weight, colors, and genuine transparent RGBA background. No tail, no water, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.
